observations: A rounded head shape fills most of the canvas against a flat purple border; the left eye socket holds a red crosshatched form topped with spiky yellow lines, while the right holds a pink spiral coil.
The face is built from overlapping olive, ochre, and brown washes, with loose multicolored lines—blue, teal, red, white—running across the surface in no single direction.
A wide open mouth near the lower center shows white vertical marks suggesting teeth, outlined in blue and black, with yellow and teal lines trailing below it.
reading: Two mismatched eye forms—one a red grid, one a pink spiral—sit inside a broadly modeled head that reads as unsettled rather than composed. The surrounding lines do not describe anatomy so much as crowd it, pulling attention outward even as the face holds the center. The open mouth and asymmetric eyes together suggest exposure or alarm, though the warm ochre ground keeps that reading from tipping into pure distress.
